name: National Gallery of Zimbabwe

records_note: Names its board of trustees but shows sponsor logos without names or dates; no annual reports or accounts found on the site.

why_flagged: Founders' fortune tied to Angolan state oil and diamond deals.

name: Fundação Bienal de São Paulo
watch: Petrobras, Vale and Bloomberg among master sponsors.
why_flagged: Petrobras, Vale and Bloomberg among master sponsors.
records_note: The Fundação posts two-year reports from 2010-11 to 2024-25, financial statements for 2013 to 2025, a named partner list with no date, and its councils.

name: Museu de Arte Moderna de São Paulo
watch: Grupo Ultra (Ipiranga fuel distribution) is a master sponsor.
why_flagged: Grupo Ultra (Ipiranga fuel distribution) is a master sponsor.
records_note: MAM São Paulo posts annual reports for 2018 to 2025, audited statements for the same years, sponsor logos by tier undated, and its boards.

name: Mansudae Art Museum / Mansudae Art Studio Gallery, 798
watch: Opened 2009 at 2 Jiuxianqiao Lu, north-west corner of 798, marked by a Chollima statue replica; sells originals, copies, posters and stamps. Taipei Times (Jan 2017) calls it Mansudae's 'only bricks and mortar foreign representation'; The Diplomat (Aug 2018) describes a 'Korea Traditional art center' in 798 operated by North Korea since c.2016. Koryo Tours' current guide says the 798 showing is 'closed' due to sanctions. Its director lent 13 works to the 2018 Gwangju Biennale for ₩28m.
why_flagged: Opened 2009 at 2 Jiuxianqiao Lu, north-west corner of 798, marked by a Chollima statue replica; sells originals, copies, posters and stamps. Taipei Times (Jan 2017) calls it Mansudae's 'only bricks and mortar foreign representation'; The Diplomat (Aug 2018) describes a 'Korea Traditional art center' in 798 operated by North Korea since c.2016. records_note: No official website, report, accounts, funder list or board turned up for the state-run Mansudae studio gallery in Beijing, which is under international sanctions.

name: Art Macao
records_note: Art Macao is run by the Cultural Affairs Bureau, which names six casino operators as co-organisers for 2025 but publishes no report, accounts or board.

name: Bienal de La Habana
watch: In October 2021 an open letter with over 400 signatures called for a boycott of the 14th edition; at least five participants withdrew.
why_flagged: State-sponsored show organised since 1984 by the government-supported Wifredo Lam Center of Contemporary Art.
records_note: The Wifredo Lam Center's site, which runs the Havana Biennial, failed to open, so none of the four questions could be checked.
other_findings: WikiLeaks, 2003-08: Two Dutch government-funded foundations, the Prince Claus Fund among them, stopped funding the Biennial in protest at Cuba's March 2003 jailing of 75 activists. (Cablegate 03THEHAGUE2114)

name: Kunsten Museum of Modern Art Aalborg
watch: Det Obelske Familiefond holds about 14.5% of Scandinavian Tobacco Group.
why_flagged: Det Obelske Familiefond holds about 14.5% of Scandinavian Tobacco Group.
records_note: Kunsten posts annual reports from 2016 to 2025 with accounts, names its funding foundations in the 2021 report, and lists its six-person board.
